name: FrenchModelVariant341_HandleRequest
evidence: matching french_model_variant/variant341_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a fan of Gouraud quads, a moving ring, a nine-point band and three line webs follow a model part towards a point 450 units in front of or behind the slot); for a non-negative request it selects the config record at data + 0xFC indexed by the request, takes three model parts, aims at the target and packs five texture images, otherwise it runs one frame through the fan, ring, band and web helpers and returns 4 in phases 2 to 4, 1 once in phase 6, 2 in phase 8 after the light fade and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the US header-324 images build the French header-341 source with the palette column 512 instead of 640; the PAL images bind its data 0xC lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
